notes:
## Changes
- Save image… in the 3D view now saves a report-sized JPEG (up to 1920 px on the long side, typically well under 200 KB) so it doesn't bloat reports. Save full-resolution PNG… keeps the full Retina frame when you need it. Copied images are report-sized too.

## Bug fixes
- 3D view image exports and copies were blank: they captured the empty window behind the 3D view instead of the render. They now read the frame from the renderer.
- Calculate appeared to do nothing when contours were switched off for the sheet: the result was drawn but hidden. Finishing a calculation now switches contours back on.
- SmartSmooth and the other smooth methods could show rows of dots across the contours. This happened when a Raw grid was switched to a smooth method after the model had changed: the extra points were calculated with the new model and mixed into the old grid. That now asks you to Update the grid instead, and saved runs affected by it display cleanly again.
